name: lottery-layout-audit
title: Scratch Lottery Layout Audit
description: Audits a scratch-lottery layout (print data) file against the client's game and data specifications, and produces signed-off audit reports.

environment.AUDIT_LAYOUTS_DIR: optional - shared folder holding layout files too large to copy into the job

status.purpose: report the job's stage and next action

build.purpose: reviewed spec.md -> job_config.json (review and validation gates)

verify.purpose: compare settings with the layout file

audit.purpose: run the audit, write reports to out/

run.purpose: build + verify + audit, stopping at the first gate

test.purpose: regression suite (unit only unless --layouts is given)

exit_codes.1: refused or failed - read the log
exit_codes.2: audit completed with exceptions in the layout file
exit_codes.3: waiting on a person - spec.md has unticked review items

human_gates.action: resolve and tick every review item in jobs/<job>/spec.md
read out/audit_report.md and sign off; record the job as golden
